MVX Benchmark
	


	
		
		Overview
	

MVX Benchmark is a dataset designed to evaluate multi-video reasoning capabilities of modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs).
Most existing video benchmarks evaluate models on single-video understanding, where the model processes only one video at a time. However, many real-world scenarios require reasoning across multiple videos, such as comparing actions, matching events, or aggregating information from different video sources.
